summary: Iteration 8 — Bulk Covers, AI Descriptions, Dead-Video Cleanup, responsive and regression smoke all pass. 17/17 pytest tests green. Playwright confirmed all required data-testids on admin dashboard (bulk-covers, cleanup-dead-xvideos, unavailable-videos, cfg-deleted-feed-xvideos) and landing edit (l-generate-copy, l-intro, l-meta-desc). Persisted AI copy on landing 3 verified: intro=673 chars, meta_description=160 chars; generated cover /generated/landing-3-cce518b3.jpg served via og:image absolute URL. Dead-cleanup cron endpoint acks immediately with valid bearer and rejects missing/invalid bearer with 401. AI copy sidecar rejects unauthenticated calls with 401 and short-title payloads with 422 (Pydantic validation). Bulk-covers with unknown IDs is correctly a no-op (safeguard against stray Gemini calls). 390px admin dashboard shows no document-level horizontal overflow and bulk-covers remains visible. NO live Gemini calls were performed during testing (as instructed).
critical_code_review_comments: CronController::deadCleanup correctly acks 2xx immediately via View::json before fastcgi_finish_request + XVideosDeadCleaner::runAsync — matches cron contract.
XVideosDeadCleaner::run safely short-circuits when deleted_feed_url is blank (returns skipped=true) — no destructive update when feed is unconfigured.

AdminController::bulkLanding filters requested IDs through SELECT id FROM landings WHERE id IN (...) before invoking CoverGenerator::generateManyAsync — prevents stray Gemini calls on non-existing IDs.
ai_copy.py uses hmac.compare_digest for secret check and Pydantic validation (min_length=2) — rejects invalid payloads before any LLM call.
Schema.php uses idempotent add-column migration for videos.is_available DEFAULT 1 and unavailable_at — safe on existing DB.

Video::paginate, bySlug, related, suggest and SeoController::sitemap all gate on v.is_available=1 — unavailable videos are hidden across browse, details, suggestions, sitemap. Landing::videos also enforces v.is_available=1.

Minor: Landing::save unique-slug loop (line 31) always evaluates both PDO prepare+execute AND a separate query — functionally correct but inefficient; could short-circuit once a free slug is found. Not blocking.
test_credentials: Admin admin/admin123 (HTTP Basic); CRON bearer from backend/.env WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET; DB dav/davpass.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing landing id=3 (slug amateur-best) with persisted AI intro (673 chars), meta_description (160 chars), and og_image /generated/landing-3-cce518b3.jpg was verified as-is. ZERO Emergent LLM credits spent in this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landings 1, 2, 3 all have /generated covers. test_iteration8_bulk_cleanup_copy.py covers the full bulk-covers + AI-copy + dead-cleanup + visibility surface without triggering LLM calls — reuse as regression. Do NOT POST ids[]=1|2|3 with action=covers unless you intentionally want to burn credits. Deleted-feed URL in sources.config is intentionally blank; direct `php bin/cleanup_dead.php` returns 'Skipped: no deleted-URL feed configured' — treat as expected.
